# Uspekhi – Front to Back, Powered by AI

> https://uspekhi.web.app

A technical blog by Helmar Baechle for solo developers and small teams who want to blend modern full-stack development with practical AI to ship real products faster.

## About

Focus areas: SvelteKit, Next.js, React, Firebase, AWS, cloud functions, n8n automation, AI integration, and full-stack development workflows.

This site helps developers understand how to use AI as an augmentation layer across their entire workflow—from ideation and coding to debugging and deployment—rather than treating it as a separate "magic" tool.

## What This Site Helps With

- How to use AI as an augmentation layer across your workflow (ideation, coding, debugging, deployment)
- How to choose a realistic stack (SvelteKit, Next.js, Firebase, AWS, n8n, etc.) for small, AI-powered products
- How to get a full-stack app from idea to production with minimal over-engineering
- Practical deployment strategies for solo developers and small teams
- Integrating AI capabilities into web applications without overcomplicating the stack

## Featured Articles (Start Here)

### Will AI Replace Devs Who Don't Use AI?
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/ai-skins-or-be-replaced
Why AI augmentation is becoming a baseline skill, not a nice-to-have. Explores how developers who don't integrate AI into their workflow may struggle to stay competitive.

### Ship a SvelteKit App with Firebase
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/svelte
A realistic path from idea to live app using SvelteKit and Firebase. Complete guide covering setup, development, and deployment for production-ready applications.

### Firebase vs Netlify vs AWS
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/firebase-netlify-or-amazon-aws
How to pick an infrastructure stack as a solo builder in 2026. Practical comparison of hosting platforms with real-world cost and complexity considerations.

## Core Technical Guides

### Deploy Next.js to Firebase
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/next-deploy
Step-by-step guide to deploying a Next.js project to Firebase Hosting, including configuration tips, environment variables, and common pitfalls to avoid.

### The Shift from Static to Generative
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/gemini
How to integrate Google's Gemini model into a Next.js application on Firebase. Covers patterns for calling LLMs safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.

### Build with Astro
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/astro
Modern static site generation with Astro. When to use Astro vs Next.js/SvelteKit, and how to leverage its content-focused architecture.

### n8n with Docker: Build AI Agents Fast
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/docker
Use n8n, Docker, and LLMs to build intelligent automations and simple AI agents in minutes—without managing complex infrastructure or learning DevOps.

### Cloud Functions for Full-Stack Apps
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/cloud
Practical guide to serverless functions with Firebase Cloud Functions and AWS Lambda. When to use them, how to structure them, and cost optimization tips.

## Mobile & Distribution

### A WebView Wrapper Guide
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/playstore
How to wrap your web app in a WebView and publish it to the Google Play Store, so one codebase serves web and mobile users. Includes Play Store submission process.

## Development Tools & Fixes

### Fixing Tailwind Errors in Vite
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/TailwindFix
Practical fixes for Tailwind CSS v4 issues in Vite projects, with copy-pasteable configuration snippets and troubleshooting common build errors.

### Google Analytics Setup
https://uspekhi.web.app/posts/Google-Analytics
How to properly set up Google Analytics 4 in modern web applications, including Next.js and SvelteKit integration patterns.

## Author

**Helmar Baechle**
Full-stack developer focused on practical AI integration, modern web stacks, and helping small teams get from prototype to production quickly.

Expertise: Next.js, SvelteKit, React, Firebase, AWS, AI/LLM integration, automation with n8n, cloud architecture for solo developers.

## Technology Stack Covered

**Frontend:** SvelteKit, Next.js, React, Astro
**Backend:** Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Hosting, Functions), AWS (Lambda, S3, CloudFront)
**AI/ML:** Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, LLM integration patterns
**DevOps:** Docker, n8n automation, CI/CD with GitHub Actions
**Styling:** Tailwind CSS
**Mobile:** WebView wrappers for Android/iOS
